arms.free: no mode requirement; global beta<=0.70 and common constraints
arms.grip: beta<=0.12 through pass, speed>=4 m/s, common actuator/road constraints
arms.required_slide: four frames with beta in [0.20,0.60] and rear slip>=0.15 before true contact; global beta<=0.70 and speed>=4 m/s through pass

claim_boundary: finite Chrono/TMeasy cells only; supports the bounded force-envelope theorem bridge but does not prove a universal detailed-vehicle theorem

decision_rule.falsify: under healthy complete searches, any pooled required-slide or early-slide free trajectory beats pooled grip by more than 0.25 m
decision_rule.inconclusive: any completeness, free, replay, frame, tire, or seed-robustness gate fails
decision_rule.support: all positive, health, pooled no-drift, seed-robust no-drift, and no-free-slide-counterexample gates pass in every full cell

metric.d_star: minimum obstacle-center distance cleared; smaller is better

negative_result_policy: M3267's planar incompleteness remains visible and cannot be overwritten by this panel
pooling_rule: Persist dedicated grip/required-slide/free searches, then re-evaluate every stored best trajectory under every mode predicate. Use pooled constrained D-stars for the primary comparison while retaining dedicated free-search consistency.

positive_and_health_gates.dedicated_all_arms_complete: every arm and every optimizer seed has finite D-star
positive_and_health_gates.free_consistency: dedicated free D-star <= min pooled constrained D-star +0.25 m
positive_and_health_gates.pooled_all_arms_complete: every cell has finite pooled grip, slide, and free D-star
positive_and_health_gates.same_plant_slide_entry: M3266 full protocol gates remain true
positive_and_health_gates.seed_robust_no_drift: worst dedicated grip seed <= best dedicated slide seed +0.25 m
positive_and_health_gates.tire_truth: every best search has finite rear-tire telemetry

primary_claim: Within the frozen Chrono/TMeasy lane-aligned static-OBB cells, the pooled minimum clearable distance of grip-mode trajectories is no larger than that of required controlled-slide trajectories by more than 0.25 m.

seed_discipline.arms: disjoint optimizer streams with identical budgets
